_notes: FLOORSHOT v102 (-floorshot harness, Assets/Scripts/FloorShot.cs). Camera poses and A/B arms for the flickering grey stipple patch Dom circled on the arena floor behind Joan (dom_floor_shadow_v99_0805.webp, dom_floor_shadow_flicker_v100.png). Every pose / arm is data: add a row, no code. pose = camera relative to the PLAYER fighter (roster player): behindM along -forward, leftM to her left, heightM above her feet, aim point = feet + forward*lookAheadM + up*lookHeightM. The pose numbers below are an ESTIMATE read from Dom's screenshot (low, close, behind Joan, sword side to the right); edit them and re-run if the patch is not in frame. region = screen fractions x0,y0,x1,y1 (y from the bottom) of the floor part of the frame that the flicker metrics use. Arms: lodBias > 0 sets QualitySettings.lodBias (0 = leave); forceLod >= 0 calls LODGroup.ForceLOD on every LODGroup whose hierarchy path contains floorMatch (the runtime equal of perf_mem_build.json E2 keepLods 1; -1 = leave); fadeMode None|CrossFade|SpeedTree sets LODGroup.fadeMode on the floor groups ('' = leave); hideRendererMatch hides enabled renderers whose name contains any entry (blood / wound / gore quads); decalProjectorsOff disables every HDRP DecalProjector (wound decals). No fight is run, so no blood / wound is created in this harness: the hide lists are for scene objects that already exist. Arms are applied on top of the baseline and fully undone before the next arm.
